text: # GEO report: quay-store **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 12 ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. High = (12 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. Both are capped at 40 because of a blocker: `static/robots.txt:4-5` blocks Googlebot from the whole site. Your `robots.txt` tells Google to stay away from the whole site. The pages are also built in the browser, so crawlers that don't run JavaScript see an empty page. Nothing was left unknown. These results are read from code. They were not measured on a live site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Googlebot - **Why it matters:** Google is told not to read any page, so none of your pages can appear in Google results. - **Where:** `static/robots.txt:4` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Googlebot` followed by `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 72/100. GEO-009 and GEO-014 become Clear (+6 points) and the cap of 40 is lifted. ### 2. Make the page content arrive in the server HTML - **Why it matters:** Many crawlers don't run JavaScript. With server rendering off, they get only an empty shell, with no headings, text or menu links. - **Where:** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` - **What the code says:** `export const ssr = false;` - **Size:** Small. Remove the line, or prerender the pages. - **Score after this:** 60/100 on its own. Fix item 1 as well, because the cap of 40 applies until then. With both fixes it is 84/100. ### 3. Add `lang` and the missing shop description - **Why it matters:** `lang` tells machines the page language. An empty description gives them nothing to show for the shop page. - **Where:** `src/app.html:2` and `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` - **What the code says:** `` and `` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 14/25, which is 56/100 on its own (still capped at 40 until item 1 is fixed). With items 1 and 3 it is 20/25 = 80/100. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and within size limits | Clear | Not run | `static/robots.txt` is plain text and valid | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers can reach the site | Problem | Not run | `static/robots.txt:4-5`, site-wide. Assumed you want to be found, since there is no `geo.config.json` | | GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | `/` and `/shop` are both blocked for Googlebot by `static/robots.txt:5`. `/search` is deliberately noindex and isn't in the sitemap or nav | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on your own domain | Clear | Not run | `+page.svelte:4` and `shop/+page.svelte:4`. Domain taken from the sitemap and robots.txt, `quay.example` | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.ts:1`, site-wide | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid and complete | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`. The Product has only `name`. Google also expects `offers`, `review` or `aggregateRating` | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and robots.txt points to it | Clear | Not run | `static/sitemap.xml` is valid and `robots.txt:7` has the `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | Not run | `src/app.html:2` has no `lang` (site-wide). `shop/+page.svelte:3` has an empty description | | GEO-016 | Key routes are linked with real links | Clear | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5` uses ``. Whether they reach the served HTML depends on GEO-003 | | GEO-017 | No snippet blocking | Clear | Not run | Only `data-nosnippet` on one element (`+layout.svelte:7`), which is fine. No `nosnippet` or `max-snippet:0` found | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Not run | Read the layout and the three pages. There are no images or buttons, and the links have text | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not applicable | Not run | Not present, and not scored | ## Other problems found - **Conflicting crawler rules:** `static/robots.txt:1-2` allows everyone, but `static/robots.txt:4-5` blocks Googlebot.
